notes.title: Haptic Feedback Added!
notes.content:
Today we released version 5 of Think Space which brings in "Haptic Feedback" (aka buzz vibration) for when you touch the whiteboard with the whiteboarding tools. Adding this sensation makes it much easier to write quickly since you can actually feel the pen bump into the whiteboard! We think you'll love it!

We also made some improvements to the writing system to make it easier to write lots of text without needing to pull the trigger for every character or line. You can now simply hold down the trigger, and writing like normal by slightly lifting your hand from the board between characters (just like how a real whiteboard works). The haptic feedback plays an important role here since you'll feel a small buzz when you hand is in contact with the board and also when it leaves the board (so you know you lifted your hand high enough). In our new raw unedited video on our page, you can see how fast writing can be with the new trigger design, and also how clean writing is when we quickly write the numbers 1-10.

Here some features
- Haptic feedback for all board tools.
- Ability hold down trigger for continuous writing with hand lifting.
- Added seagull sounds
- Lowered the volume of the ocean sounds.

As always please keep the feedback coming, and more updates are always coming!

Thanks,
Jason

notes.title: Easier writing!
notes.content:
Hey Think Spacers,

I just wanted to update everyone on the latest changes that went out in the most recent Think Space update today!

- We've removed the need to pull the trigger to write! Just touch to draw  now.
- The ocean audio clips have been improved to seamlessly loop
- The marker colors are now more vibrant, and won't be affected by lighting.

Please keep the great feedback coming! Think Space will continue evolving and adding features, and we count on the community to let us know what is/isn't working great for them!

Take Care,
Jason

notes.title: New Immersive Island Experience!
notes.content:
Today we're launching Think Space v3, which features a COMPLETE visual redesign! Over the past month, we've been busy designing custom visual assets that make Think Space more immersive and beautiful! For example, the new marker and eraser tools have been modeled as exact replicas of real whiteboarding tools right down to the notches on the back side of the marker.

Multiuser got a massive face lift as well! We've replaced the blocky generic avatars, with a custom designed Think Space Panda character. Now when you join multiuser meetings, everyone will be a distinct panda character/avatar with a different t-shirt color, which makes collaboration in Think Space so much more fun!

Here's quick list of the major changes:
- New ocean water
- New island shape
- New dock stretching over water
- New seagulls flying around the island
- New realistic marker & eraser models
- New panda avatar for multiuser
- New sky with clouds
- New palm trees
- New beach sand texture
- New rocks on the island
- New mountain with "Vista Point" lookout
- New textures and lighting
- Ability to walk nearly anywhere on the island
- Performance and bug fixes, as always

notes.title: Multiuser is here!!!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Think Space Multiuser is now live!

This update brings full remote collaboration to Think Space, and we're really excited about the creativity this will unlock for remote teams!

New Features:
- Real-time editing of whiteboards by multiple users
- Voice chat in meetings
- Start multiuser meetings
- Join multiuser meetings
- Open documents during meetings
- Save document during meetings
- People are announced by name when they join or leave a meeting
- All meetings are cloud connected for speed and stability
- Avatar for each user in meeting

We can't wait to see how you use it, so please post screenshots and feedback to the Steam community page! More features are in the works, and we'll post on Steam when updates are pushed!
